situation: Small, fast (7-day lead time), well-performing family seal firm, and the natural one supplier for the seal kit in P15 (25,000 kits/yr: 2 O-ring sets, 1 gasket, 2 lip seals). The kit roughly triples our spend with it (~132 k EUR at current prices), which is exactly what it wants. The owner has offered an open-book walk-through.
